title: Review queue
intro: Held and reported questions, appeals, and signs of coordinated voting. Vote counts are shown here; which way people answered never is.

empty.questions: Nothing waiting. Held and reported questions appear here.

done.question: Question #{id} updated.
done.banned: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody was banned.} one {# account banned permanently for vote manipulation.} other {# accounts banned permanently for vote manipulation.}}
done.scan: Scan finished: {n, plural, =0 {no new signals} one {# new signal} other {# new signals}}.

item.reports: {n, plural, =0 {no open reports} one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
item.aiReview: AI review: answerable true or false {answerable, select, true {yes} other {no}}; names a private person {private_person, select, true {yes} other {no}}; harassing or hateful {harassing_or_hateful, select, true {yes} other {no}}.

reasons.not_yes_no: It can't be answered true or false

actions.removeFixNote: Shown to the asker: how the question could be asked instead.
actions.harmNone: No, it only needs rewording (no penalty)
actions.mergeRule: Votes are combined by the rule “{rule}”: {explain}
actions.subject: Subject

harm.private_person: Targets a private person (adds a demerit)

rules.move_unanswered_keep_original: people who answered only the repeat have their answer moved to the original; people who answered both keep their answer on the original.

appeals.about: Appeal #{id} · {subject, select, question {removed question} ban {ban} demerit {demerit} other {item}} #{subjectId}
appeals.autoRemoved: Removed automatically by the report rule.
appeals.noteHelp: Shown to them with the outcome.
appeals.overturnHelp: Overturning restores a removed question, lifts a ban, or revokes a demerit.

signals.summary: {n, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} under {days} days old gave the same answer within {minutes} minutes.
signals.question: On question #{id}: {text}
signals.votes: {n, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} in total
signals.accountsHelp: Confirming bans the ticked accounts permanently. Only accounts in the burst can be banned: never the asker, never honest voters.

errors.self_merge: A question can't be a repeat of itself.
errors.original_not_live: The original isn't live, so it can't take the merge.
errors.already_merged: That question has already been merged.
errors.already_removed: That question has already been removed.
errors.why_and_fix_required: Removing a question needs both why and a suggested fix.
errors.note_required: Add a note explaining the decision.
errors.own_appeal: You can't decide your own appeal.
errors.decided: That appeal has already been decided.
errors.reviewed: That signal has already been reviewed.
errors.unavailable: The AI review didn't answer. Try again later.

denial.demerit: This added a demerit to your account. Repeated harmful questions bring a temporary ban from asking.
